g.text: Parser and service rules (not DB CHECK constraints)
PKs and required list/product/listing foreign keys.
Quantity must be 1..999; checked state is not a purchase.
One My list is used; accepted-import writes use ID 1.
Reject negative prices and inputs needing decimal rounding.
selectedRetailerCode is nullable and has no FK.
Null = lowest priced listing, if available; keep unavailable explicit choices.
Language fields: nullable embedded columns, not a separate table.
Require all five product labels in three languages; offers may be blank.
Diamonds: JPA-owned children or embedded values.
Keep inactive products for saved references; offers remain text.
J05-J08 records copy product/retailer codes; no FK to listings.
Observations survive catalogue replacement (D02); identity = product+retailer+checksum+period (D03).
Unique observation identity (product, retailer, checksum, period).
Unknown price stored with known=false; used for provenance only (D03).
Reminder unique per product; budget settings singleton ID 1.
